body.statement: Nguyen, Barrett, and Jun deliver estimator-specific mean-squared-error upper bounds for the largest empirical mean and HAVER, including instance-dependent guarantees; they do not state a global all-estimator minimax lower bound over bounded Bernoulli arm laws.

source.verbatim_statement: The theorem above provides a fine-grained, instance-dependent upper bound on the MSE of HAVER.

attestation.note: Scope transcribed and audited against arXiv:2411.00405v2, especially Theorems 4--6 and the corollary list; no all-estimator minimax theorem is stated there.

body.justification: This records only the comparator's delivery boundary needed by the one-group theorem's final literature clause.
body.gap: It does not serve as a mathematical premise for the new lower bound.
